# VMD correction diagnosis

The completed forty-setting search is retained unchanged. Its preferred Fz
selection subset scored 5.2274 dB for projected VMD versus 10.4617 dB for direct
regression under the archived objective. This does not prove VMD decomposition
is invalid; it requires checking the correction layer before calling the method
successful. The rolling solver already has numerical parity tests against vmdpy.

Notebook 04a checks three distinct mechanisms on Kaggle:

- Reconstruct the original input from all saved modes plus the saved residual.
  This detects scaling, cropping or mode-vector errors independently of scoring.
- Project every mode and the residual against exactly the same references and
  ridge settings. Their sum must equal direct projection by linearity. This
  control cannot be described as an independent VMD improvement.
- Compare selected-mode projection using the scoring-window EOG mean versus
  an explicitly declared unscored calibration EOG baseline. Partition total
  MSE into squared mean bias and centered error variance to inspect offsets.

The calibration-baseline alternative estimates coefficients from centered EEG
and EOG, then applies them to EOG excursions relative to the calibration mean.
It consumes no clean target. Calibration lag means exclude samples crossing
trial boundaries. Its defaults do not replace any existing algorithm or running
experiment. Clean-input modification must be measured before it becomes a
candidate teacher. Corrected-mean SNR is not used as the output-SNR target.

Saved outputs include per-channel paper metrics, clean preservation, mode-gate
counts, reconstruction/projection closure, residual projection RMS and error
bias. True controlled artifact values appear only in diagnosis, never inference.
This first mechanism check retains the original Fz scope; an improvement there
must subsequently survive all-frontal, full-regional and grouped comparisons.

Verified first diagnostic (`vmd-diagnosis-001`, source fc79b30) passed 51 tests
and retained all 128 selection examples. Maximum relative reconstruction error
was 5.5863e-8 and mode-plus-residual projection closure error was 5.8510e-8.
Matched direct regression scored 8.6741 dB; the all-components algebraic control
scored identically. This matched comparator has lag zero and differs from the
original best direct-regression candidate (10.4617 dB with a wider lag bank).
VMD calibration baselines scored 5.2706 versus 5.2274 dB for the original mode
correction. Thus baseline handling alone does not explain the recovery deficit.
All six initial controls reported zero modification on the scored clean subset.

The next saved notebook version adds explicit all-mode, residual and capped-fit
controls, per-mode projection magnitudes and the declared association-threshold
ablations. It uses actual summed component projections for the closure control.
These are mechanism experiments, not a selected replacement teacher. Lower
thresholds must report their clean-input cost; no threshold is accepted just
because its dirty-input SNR improves.

The second diagnostic (`vmd-diagnosis-002`, source 9ed2d35) passed 59 tests.
All 14 payload checksums matched and the saved correction-control figure was
visually inspected. At K4/alpha2000, reducing the mode threshold to 0.2 scored
9.1894 dB but produced 35.0809% worst-recipient clean RRMSE; threshold 0.4 had
the same clean cost. Adding the projected residual to selected modes scored
5.7340 dB with 2.9008% clean RRMSE. These alternatives fail preservation and
cannot become an approved teacher. Recomputed unit-invariant associations
gave identical threshold outcomes on this Fz subset; the feature repair alone
does not resolve its deficit. The unit repair remains required for general
dimensionless behavior and train-only FCM features.

The next mechanism experiment separates raw-channel/window detection from
mode selection. It crosses the existing 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 threshold bank at each
level and evaluates all three declared lag banks against matched direct
regression. A capped VMD fit remains pass-through. Fixed K/alpha/penalty/strength
remain unchanged; no clean target enters either detector. This adapts the
two-stage detection/decomposition idea in [Xiong et al., sections 2.1–2.4](https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/sensors/sensors-24-01642/article_deploy/sensors-24-01642-v2.pdf?version=1709543478).
The paper uses an SVM detector plus SOBI and approximate-entropy component
selection; our EOG association gates are explicitly different. The paper's
SOBI delay set is unspecified in those sections and its printed K/alpha example
conflicts with the declared ranges, so those details cannot be silently claimed
replicated. Diagnosis-only threshold results must survive source-grouped
parameter selection and full-montage/native evaluation before promotion.

# References that affect implementation

Evaluation equations, source locations, discrepancies and adaptations are
specified in [EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md](EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md). Project preservation
thresholds are not paper-standard metrics or published acceptance thresholds.

The [2026-10-10 alternatives review](RESEARCH_ALTERNATIVES_20261010.md) and
`notebooks/20_Literature_Challengers.ipynb` distinguish existing controls from
new selective-ICA, frontal-MVMD, VME-GMETV and deterministic neural-refinement
challengers. They record access gaps and proposed experiments; no alternative
is promoted or substituted into the active campaign by this literature review.

## VMD

Dragomiretskiy and Zosso, *Variational Mode Decomposition*, IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing (2014), [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/TSP.2013.2288675). The algorithm learns band-limited modes and center frequencies jointly. It does not justify K=5 by naming five physiological EEG bands.

[vmdpy reference](https://github.com/vrcarva/vmdpy) is the parity oracle for the independently copied rolling solver. The original implementation keeps iteration history; our solver keeps two spectral buffers and the reference return convention. RMS normalization makes stopping behavior independent of signal units. Uniform initialization, tau=0, no forced DC, tolerance 1e-6 and cap 2000 are declared. A separate residual preserves incomplete reconstruction.

Selection compares K=3..10, alpha 250/500/1000/2000/4000, lag banks, ridge penalties, association thresholds and strengths. Center proximity alone cannot prove over-segmentation: bandwidth and spectral overlap also matter. Retained EEG and grouped recovery decide whether extra modes help.

## Frontal VMD–SOBI candidate

[Xiong et al., SVM–IVMD–SOBI](https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/sensors/sensors-24-01642/article_deploy/sensors-24-01642-v2.pdf?version=1709543478),
sections 2.1–2.4, motivates a separate contamination detector and mode-domain
second-order source separation. `sobi.py` independently implements whitening,
symmetric delayed covariances and orthogonal Jacobi joint diagonalization;
`vmd_sobi.py` evaluates reconstructed source subtraction versus EOG-projected
source correction. Source means and the VMD residual stay in the input.
Declared delay banks and EOG-based detection are adaptations, not the paper's
unspecified delay bank or SVM/GA replication. Approximate entropy uses m=2,
r=0.15 SD with self matches and a declared 0.4 threshold for the optional
entropy-plus-EOG branch. No superiority is assumed before Kaggle evidence.
The bounded plan and promotion criteria are in `VMD_SOBI_PLAN.md`.

## Posterior MWF implementation

[Authors' MATLAB implementation](https://github.com/exporl/mwf-artifact-removal) provides calibration-mask covariance and generalized-eigenvalue artifact estimation. Our `posterior.py` adapts its GEVD operator, with Ledoit–Wolf covariance regularization and selectable positive excess rank. Analytic diagonal and nonorthogonal fixtures check the equation independently. This is an adaptation with changed covariance estimation, not a claim of full MATLAB pipeline replication.

Posterior-only estimation and signed frontal support are compared under the same inputs. Calibration lag columns exclude trial joins. Increasing rank or lag embedding changes preservation and cubic spatial-fitting cost; neither is assumed beneficial.

## ICA and qualified eye calibration

[Picard author implementation](https://github.com/pierreablin/picard) supplies extended nonorthogonal ICA. Component selection uses signed lagged HEOG/VEOG association on calibration data. PCA residuals are preserved by subtracting only selected-component artifacts from the original EEG. Failed convergence is a scored passthrough.

[Kobler eye-artifact correction code](https://github.com/rkobler/eyeartifactcorrection) motivates separate eye movement/blink calibration and native real-data evaluation. SGEYESUB is not called replicated until its specific calibration and reference implementation are qualified. An unvalidated approximation will not be reported as that method.

## Source evidence

[Raw LEMON publisher download page](http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/retro/MPI_LEMON/downloads/download_EEG.html) supplies participant archive URLs. Only development raw EEG is opened before model freeze. The publisher OSF readme defines global IDs, EEG/EOG types and trial/sample labels. [Magdeburg DOI](https://doi.org/10.24352/UB.OVGU-2020-155) is reserved for independent waveform evaluation after freeze; metadata audit alone is not waveform validation.

# Native paper evaluation implementation

This Phase A extension preserves the existing source split and search outputs.
It closes the gap between short cache-window proxies and the condition-level
evaluation in the Kobler author demo. No reserved source is opened.

1. Validate streaming condition-level Pearson/RMSE against actual concatenation.
2. Validate multi-method overlap-add, with EEG and references aligned and every
   original sample covered. Filter each trial before any concatenation.
3. Read only development OSF recordings named in the completed corpus ledger.
   Reuse its calibration arrays, scoring trial IDs and held-out-fold recipes.
4. Correct complete trials using identity, direct regression, regional VMD–MWF
   and regional VMD–ICA. Save trial identities, corrections and failures.
5. Evaluate concatenated-condition Pearson and rest RMSE per channel. Prefer
   the publisher's exact HEOG_lpf/VEOG_lpf channels when present; disclose raw
   HEOG/VEOG fallback instead of inventing the missing derivative.
6. Compute Welch spectra separately within each rest trial. Combine spectra
   by the number of eligible two-second segments, never across trial joins.
7. Construct contiguous eight-second rest/ocular banks. Bootstrap five distinct
   verified participants for 5,000 repetitions and retain all random draws.
   Whole-montage averaging over channels then participants and non-overlapping
   banks are declared adaptations; this is not an exact four-region EEGOAR
   replication or an equivalence test.
8. Run a focused Kaggle fixture and two-record original-source pilot. Launch
   the full development job only after these checks pass.

Primary source: https://github.com/rkobler/eyeartifactcorrection/blob/master/demo_main.m
lines 121–145. EEGOAR section 2.4.1 supplies the eight-second chance analysis,
Welch durations and paired-permutation design; unresolved choices remain in
docs/EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md. Numerical execution and plotting remain Kaggle-only.

# VMD–SOBI frontal candidate: bounded implementation plan

## Why this candidate is necessary

Reference-projected VMD alone has not beaten direct regression. In the fixed
K4/alpha2000 Fz mechanism experiment, two-stage channel/mode gating protected
the scored clean inputs but lag-bank-1 mode-threshold-0.2 correction scored
8.8051 dB versus 10.4617 dB for matched direct regression. This cannot qualify
the teacher. The VMD solver's parity and reconstruction checks passed, so a
different correction mechanism is warranted before rejecting decomposition.

[Xiong et al. 2024, sections 2.1–2.4](https://mdpi-res.com/d_attachment/sensors/sensors-24-01642/article_deploy/sensors-24-01642-v2.pdf?version=1709543478)
uses a detector, VMD, SOBI on its modes and approximate-entropy source
selection. This candidate adapts the mode-domain SOBI step, with available
HEOG/VEOG supplying additional source evidence. It is not a full replication
of their SVM/GA pipeline or an already superior approach.

## Module contracts

| Component | Input | Output | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Symmetric joint diagonalizer | delayed symmetric covariance matrices | orthogonal rotation, objective and convergence | known commuting matrices diagonalized; objective decreases |
| SOBI | finite mode vectors `[K,T]`, declared delays | whitened sources, unmixing/mixing operators, mean and rank | recover identifiable mixed autoregressive sources; retain rank residual and units |
| Approximate entropy | one source, m=2, r=0.15 SD | ApEn including self matches | independent direct-count oracle; amplitude invariance; explicit constant rule |
| Candidate correction | modes, EOG, SOBI operator, raw-channel trigger | mode-domain artifact, summed once into raw EEG | targets never enter inference; failed fits pass through |
| Notebook 04b | corpus/2 and VMD/1 | paper metrics, failure counts, clean costs, diagnostic figures | Kaggle contracts pass, then bounded pilot; no model authorization |

The primary agent authors modules; all numerical checks and figures run on
Kaggle. No neural architecture or student training is introduced.

## Bounded search and interpretation

The pilot reuses immutable K4/alpha2000 vectors and the original lag-zero
penalty/strength. It evaluates two explicit SOBI delay banks: samples
`[1,2,4,8,16,32]` and `[1,5,10,20,40,80]` at 200 Hz. These are declared choices;
the inspected paper does not specify its complete delay bank. Center/scale
normalization and a relative covariance-rank criterion avoid unit-dependent
source fits. Cap Jacobi sweeps at 100 with rotation tolerance 1e-7; record
convergence, diagonalization cost and off-diagonal residual.

Compare whole identified-source subtraction, reference-projected source
subtraction and entropy-plus-EOG selection. Use the existing association
threshold bank, retain residual and means, and use the separate raw-channel
trigger to protect clean windows. Approximate-entropy threshold 0.4, embedding
2 and radius fraction 0.15 are explicitly identified adaptations of the paper;
our 5.12-second windows and EOG-assisted selection differ.

The pilot first covers 12 development examples. A passing software pilot
permits a 128-example mechanism comparison, not teacher approval. Promotion
requires recipient/donor-grouped parameter selection, full frontal channels,
regional/posterior integration, native suppression/preservation and all
existing acceptance gates. Confirmation sources remain closed.

## Pilot evidence and next checkpoint

completed on Kaggle with 63 tests passing and zero fit failures across 12
development examples. Its 14 retrieved payload hashes matched the immutable

regression reached 8.9368 dB. Scored clean RRMSE was zero for both. Whole-source
and entropy-assisted subtraction performed worse. These small-subset results

# High-level and low-level execution plan

## Objective and boundaries

Recover recipient EEG from blink and lateral-eye contamination, measure source-level uncertainty, and retain declared clean EEG. Controlled SNR >=15dB is the target; 20dB is a stretch target. Numerical work, tests, figures and training run on Kaggle. Git modules are the source of truth. The user conditionally authorizes neural work only after every classical gate passes.

## High-level flow

1. Verify original source bytes and metadata; preserve historical exposure labels.
2. Freeze source identities, reserving 20% of new cohort identities with seed 42 before extracting windows.
3. Validate signal and solver contracts; create independent calibration/scoring segments.
4. Generate controlled recipient/donor mixtures and retain native real EEG separately.
5. Search forty VMD K/alpha settings, correction parameters and posterior algorithms.
6. Select configurations outside each held-out recipient/donor bucket; compare regional, shared and no-context alternatives.
7. Review all preservation, correlation and SNR gates. Require VMD value beyond matched direct regression.
8. After a passing gate: source-isolated teacher targets, EEG-only baseline, distillation and grouped multi-seed model selection.
9. Freeze exactly one model and analysis; open reserved and independent evaluation once.
10. Verify CPU loading, whole-record overlap-add and cap scaling; deliver artifacts and limitations.

## Module contracts

| Module | Input | Output | Dependencies | Owner | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contracts.py` | run specification, approval evidence | validated immutable identity | strict JSON | primary agent | invalid identities and unauthorized stages rejected |
| `io.py` | versioned source bundle | verified original source tree, hashes | archive manifest | primary agent | checksum mismatch/path escape rejected |
| `osf_reader.py` | original `.set/.fdt` | `[trial,channel,time]`, names, integer labels | publisher format | primary agent | EEG/EOG/annotation axes and FDT length verified |
| `data.py` | original files and IDs | audit, source partitions, development caches | I/O, reader | primary agent | metadata-backed EOG axes; reserved cache absent |
| `signal.py` | one continuous segment | 200Hz 0.5–40Hz EEG, overlap-add correction | scipy | primary agent | no trial/calibration joins filtered together; identity overlap-add |
| `reference.py` | EEG `[C,T]`, EOG `[2,T]` | signed association and artifact projection | lag convention | primary agent | lag oracle, polarity invariance, collinearity |
| `vmd.py` / `frontal.py` | one channel plus references | `[K,T]` vectors, residual, selective correction | reference implementation | primary agent | vmdpy parity; retain residual; record convergence |
| `posterior.py` | unscored calibration and original scoring EEG | ICA/MWF artifact on posterior channels | scipy/Picard | primary agent | analytic GEVD fixtures; sufficient rank/rest/ocular duration |
| `corpus.py` | recipient prefix/scoring, donor calibration/scoring | controlled mixtures, clean controls, recipes | frozen source partitions | primary agent | exact-name montage intersection; recipient/donor held out together |
| `experiments.py` | archived corpus and search artifacts | full tables, grouped comparison, strict classical gate | classical modules | primary agent | all eligible failures retained; no target-dependent inference |
| notebook builder | stage and published SHA | clean checkout/execution notebook | Git remote | primary agent | actual SHA recorded and matches launch SHA |
| Kaggle CLI launcher | clean published branch | versioned kernel, run manifest | Kaggle OAuth | primary agent | no stale source; output identity checked |
| monitor | kernel status/logs | completion/error reports | Kaggle API | GPT-6 Luna high | distinguish API errors from numerical failures |
| neural modules | passing gate, approved recipe | EEG-only model and export | not implemented before gate | primary agent | identity/mask/permutation tests and final independent evaluation |

## Research controls

OSF has no paired native clean signal. Its globally unique participant IDs are documented by the publisher readme. Klados's unknown montage and participant mapping remain unknown. Raw LEMON is a low-ocular recipient reference, not guaranteed biological clean EEG. Controlled artifacts are spatially coherent donor-calibration projections; this family can favor regression, so superiority cannot be inferred from its SNR alone.

Configuration selection excludes the target recipient/donor bucket. Window-adaptive EOG projection uses no clean target. ICA/MWF use unscored calibration only. Modes are adaptive vectors, not physiological bands. Close centers are recorded as diagnostics. Iteration-limited/error fits pass through and remain scored. Regional experts all see original input; their disjoint corrections are subtracted once.

## Execution checkpoints and repairs

Every stage records source SHA, configuration, split identities, parent evidence, package/hardware information, logs, hashes and status. New source revisions require a new Kaggle notebook version/run ID. Failed evidence is retained. A focused contract check precedes dependent execution. Reproduction uses archived SHAs; latest is resolved once at launch.

The live completion ledger is `TARGETS.md`. An authored module is not marked research-validated merely because it parses or its kernel runs. Parameter searches require result inspection; classical gate failure keeps models closed and never opens confirmation data for tuning.

## Locked policy

AutoVMD is disabled. On 11 October the authenticated Kaggle status for
`satyapaladugu/vmd-band-search-f0-k4-a1000` was CANCEL_ACKNOWLEDGED.
Historical caches remain immutable. The earlier archived replay ERROR is retained;
the repaired cache-only replay guard17-cache-replay-003 reproduced17.92721 dB.
It remains a separate unknown-montage, EOG-assisted historical benchmark.

All VMD calls are frontal only, with names checked against declared anatomical
metadata. Unknown/E1 and posterior/central/FC names are not assigned frontal.
Fixed K3/alpha2000 and fixed K4/alpha2000 are the only project recipes. No K/alpha
optimizer or neural screening is called. Completed caches are imported by exact
manifest, waveform, solver, corpus, split and scope identities.

## Numerical experiment

Inputs: corpus/2, readiness/1, passing frontal fixture, K3 cache/1 and K4 cache/1.
Pilot: one recipient per frozen bucket, clean and blink/lateral/mixed at 0 dB.
Full heldout evaluation: first deterministic window per
recipient/condition/-5/0/5 dB (320 examples).
Both score **every verified frontal channel** and leave every other channel alone.

Matched controls: identity and direct joint HEOG/VEOG ridge. Mode mechanisms:
whole selected mode, reference-projected mode, temporal interval projection,
mode-domain SOBI projection. Paper adaptations: 2022 selector structure and
2024 fixed-recipe SVM/SOBI/ApEn; exact-reproduction limitations are in
FRONTAL_PAPER_AUDIT.md. No targets or known mixture artifacts enter inference.

Pilot: triggers .4/.6, component thresholds .2/.4, strengths .5/1, instantaneous
ridge .01. Full: declared four association/strength settings for mode arms;
direct comparator additionally covers declared three lag banks and penalties.
This is a bounded correction study, not a restarted parameter search. Direct
regression is explicitly window-adaptive, not falsely described as calibration
coefficient fitting. Event support uses unchanged HEOG/VEOG standardized by
unscored calibration: 3 SD, 100-ms expanded support, tapered edges. These are
declared project choices, not paper constants or native zero-correlation targets.

The full follow-up adds a bounded lag/ridge ablation to the three projected
mode families: trigger .4, component threshold .2, strength 1, all declared lag
banks and ridge penalties. It does not multiply these settings across the full
threshold/strength grid. Projection cache keys include lag and penalty so a
different lag bank cannot accidentally reuse an instantaneous estimate.

Partial selection screens clean modification, alpha/beta and covariance using
training sources only. Family-wise heldout reports include CC deterioration
against the independently selected direct comparator. SVM has one predeclared
K3 correction recipe; nested tuning of crossfit detector predictions is excluded.
Native preservation, uncertainty and final family selection remain required.

In the follow-up, K3 and K4 are separate fixed comparison arms. Correction
parameters are selected within an arm; K is never selected by this workflow.
The single SVM recipe is evaluated as predeclared, without selecting an identity
fallback from other outer-fold detector predictions that may have seen the
current heldout fold. Its preservation failures are reported, not hidden.

Persist candidates, channel scores, per-example recovery shards, fold/exclusion
identities, per-axis association, solver diagnostics, mode frequency/bandwidth
information and failures. The pilot saves every candidate prediction. Partial
or failed runs retain completed shards; resume must match all identities.

## Acceptance and sequence

Output SNR >=15 dB, stretch 20 dB. Preserve worst-recipient mean clean change
<=1%, alpha/beta <=.5 dB, covariance <=.02 and CC deterioration <=.005 versus
direct comparison. These engineering gates are separate from paper metrics.
Clean-gate success alone cannot qualify teacher or posterior integration.

Frontal fixture -> pilot -> full grouped frontal evaluation -> native frontal
validation -> frontal evidence review -> posterior integration -> EEG-only model
comparison -> freeze/external evaluation -> deployment. No queued automatic
transition into posterior or neural work bypasses scientific checkpoints.

# Posterior and central correction challengers

14 October 2026 IST. User-authorized expansion of exploratory regional experiments.
This permits experiments despite the current frontal/native qualification failure;
it does not promote a teacher, open confirmation sources or authorize neural training.

## Question and frozen context

Can selectively correcting ocular spatial components improve posterior and central
reconstruction over the existing regional hybrid? Preserve frontal K3/alpha2000
full-field predictions (17.112814 dB frontal development mean). No posterior or
central VMD, no AutoVMD and no repetition of the 737-candidate posterior grid.
Full archived central mean was10.903434 dB and posterior13.541703 dB; whole
VMD-context13.162704 dB. Regional dB scores cannot be added.

## Evidence influencing design

- Issa and Juhasz2019: wavelet correction within ocular ICA components and
  contaminated intervals rather than deleting entire components. Primary paper:
  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6956025/ . Our fixed sym4/MAD thresholds,
  calibration-only Picard fit and EOG-assisted component selection are adaptations;
  no exact author replication or EEG-only inference claim.
- Mannan, Jeong and Kamran2016: process ocular ICs using regression, retaining
  their neural contribution. Primary paper:
  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4853904/ . Our lagged ridge with frozen
  calibration coefficients replaces their entropy/MAD/extended-RLS pipeline;
  label it component-regression adaptation, not REG-ICA reproduction.
- Kobler et al2020 SGEYESUB: calibration-trained ocular subspace subtraction
  addresses dipole and eyelid activity and protects resting/ERP signals.
  https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32497788/ ; author implementation
  https://github.com/rkobler/eyeartifactcorrection . Remains a later challenger
  requiring its actual calibration paradigm/contracts and author-code parity.
  Author source inspection confirms six sample classes: left/right movement1/2,
  vertical movement3/4, blink5, rest6. The existing four trial-type codes are a
  different taxonomy; do not substitute them or fabricate directional labels
  from HEOG signs. Audit the original artifactclasses channel/calibration labels
  before porting elastic-net classifiers and the staged eye/blink matrices.
- GED identifies contrasts rather than biological truth. Reference-informed
  low-rank transfer is our project extension, not SGEYESUB or the original MWF:
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2021.118809 . Measure preservation separately.

## First experiment: six fixed mechanisms

Fit one full-available-montage ICA on each unscored calibration; output only
verified posterior or central/shared rows. Full support includes frontal channels
but never decomposes them with new VMD. Match support and association gate across
ICA correction arms. Use original EEG for every artifact estimate.

1. ICA whole selected-component subtraction: matched rejection control.
2. ICA component ridge: joint HEOG/VEOG lagged calibration regression of selected
   sources, back-projected to a complete artifact field; infer one bounded shared
   gain per output region from scoring input. Targets are absent from inference.
3. Wavelet ICA: subtract large-coefficient contribution from selected sources.
4. Selective wavelet ICA: same contribution restricted to source-amplitude events
   using calibration-rest MAD, dilation and taper. Sustained lateral events are
   evaluated explicitly; a blink-shaped detector is not assumed adequate.
5. Reference-field rank1 transfer: rest-whitened rank reduction of the calibration
   EOG-predicted field; scoring EEG determines bounded region gain.
6. Reference-field rank2 transfer: same parameters, second-rank ablation.

Each mechanism saves three compositions: posterior-only change, central-only
change and both changed. Frozen frontal output and the untouched other branch
remain exact. Baselines: identity, archived VMD-context hybrid and archived
raw-context hybrid (same frontal VMD output). No scoring-target recipe selection.

Information-access distinction: scoring ICA/wavelet arms use original full-montage
EEG, including raw frontal support. Reference-rank arms use full-montage calibration
to learn the field but scoring HEOG/VEOG plus each output region's EEG determine
correction; they do not consume the corrected frontal waveform or its estimated
ocular field. Combining these outputs with frozen frontal VMD is a regional
hybrid, not evidence of explicit VMD-to-posterior communication. After the fixed
comparison, NF09 separately tests no-context versus signed frontal summaries and
the estimated frontal ocular field, using calibration-only transfer fitting and
source-quality flags. Match raw and VMD-derived context; do not assume VMD helps.

Fixed settings: ICA association0.4; calibration ridge lags[-10,0,10], penalty0.01;
gain0..8; wavelet sym4, maximum level6 subject to valid length; rest-MAD multiplier3;
source event dilation50samples and taper10samples at200Hz. These are declared
project settings, not published optimal parameters. New recipes are experimental.

  parity, exact parent identities and failure counts remain required.

Full-development result motivates the next hypothesis: reference-rank2 raises
whole channel-first mean from13.162704 to15.155692dB, but blink+5 output falls
from19.821757 to17.562110 and mixed+5 from18.501700 to17.328050. Severe lateral
-5 remains8.050232. Diagnose weak-input overcorrection and severe-lateral residuals
before a calibration-fitted confidence/shrinkage blend with the old branch.
Such a blend is a proposed correction experiment, not a selected recipe or an
excuse to use true input-SNR labels at inference. No broad K/alpha search.

Parallel GEVD-MWF control: numbered notebook59 uses the same corpus/context
parents and reporting engine with a separate campaign. Exactly two recipes,
rank1/rank2, instantaneous full-montage support, strength1, same0.4association
gate. Calibration rest/ocular covariances use the already validated posterior
solver. No repetition of737candidate search. Saved-fit replay and baseline
metric parity are mandatory, as in notebook58; all corrections remain relative
to original input, with frontal outputs frozen. First run is50examples, not a
new teacher selection. This control is authorized alongside the320example
six-mechanism run after its pilot contracts/recovery passed.

## Reporting and stop rules

## Next mechanisms after the fixed pilot

| Priority | Mechanism and region | What changes / eligibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Existing GEVD-MWF on central/shared outputs | Reuse validated posterior.py; fixed rank1 and rank2 controls, same full/raw-frontal support, calibration rest/ocular labels and association gate. This tests central use without repeating the posterior search. |
| 2 | SGEYESUB on posterior/central outputs | Audit author demo and native OSF calibration labels/reference/channel layout; port only with author parity. Matrix subtraction after fitting is attractive for scalable devices. Do not call our reference-rank method SGEYESUB. |
| 3 | Reference CCA/iCanClean adaptation | Separate correlated artifact subspace before back-projection; HEOG/VEOG and signed frontal field as separately matched reference options. Phantom evidence is not independent human ocular validation. |
| 4 | SOBI plus selective source regression | Temporal source statistics provide a different separation from Picard. Existing SOBI code was written for VMD vectors; multichannel calibration needs numerical-rank and trial-boundary repairs before reuse. No posterior VMD. |
| 5 | ASR/rASR benchmark control | Requires eligible low-ocular calibration, common preprocessing and source-aware cutoff selection. Test reconstruction rather than rejecting samples; score every original interval. Variance selection may remove task-related neural activity and is not ocular-specific. |
| 6 | Wavelet-enhanced CCA | A published left/right common-component idea is a challenger only. Common bilateral activity can be neural and signed lateral eye activity may not be common; require reference-supported identification instead of assuming first component is ocular. |

Primary references for this extension, checked14October2026:

- iCanClean2023: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10574843/ . CCA identifies
  reference-correlated components, followed by regression/back-projection; the
  cited experiment is phantomEEG and must be reported in that scope.
- SOBINMF2015: https://doi.org/10.1541/ieejeiss.135.954 . SOBI/NMF evaluated with
  motor-imagery EEG; adding nonnegative factorization to signed EEG requires its
  actual transform/objective, not simply clipping negative electrode values.
- ASR/rASR2019: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6499032/ . Ocular amplitude
  reduction and preservation trade-offs; not evidence that ASR will beat our SNR.
- wCCA2011: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22255263/ . Inspect complete settings
  before any reproduction claim; assumptions need lateral-specific validation.
- CiSSA-DWT2023: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9921497/ . Originally
  discusses few/single frontal channels; postpone a central/posterior adaptation
  until it adds a testable hypothesis beyond the running wavelet component arms.

The central/shared label must be unpacked into verified channels in reporting;
it is a montage-defined collection rather than a biological claim that all its
electrodes have the same ocular coupling. Preserve mu/alpha and beta activity at
central electrodes and posterior alpha; ERP/BCI task preservation needs separate
eligible labelled recordings. Unknown anatomy still passes through.

Archived metadata inspection confirms the current central/shared bucket is:
C1-C6, Cz, CP1-CP6, CPz, FC1-FC6, FT7/FT8, T7/T8 and TP7/TP8. Thus its26rows
include20frontocentral/central/centroparietal rows and6temporal rows. Retain this
frozen primary bucket for matched comparisons, then report the two verified
subgroups separately on Kaggle before assigning different subgroup policies.
Names identify the audited montage; no electrode-coordinate inference is used.

EMA-ASR (28September2026preprint) is a later exploratory ASR variant:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35223 . Its10subject/24channel study reports improved
blink attenuation with increased reconstruction/spectral deviation. This is a
preservation tradeoff, not evidence of15/20dB paired reconstruction or lateral
superiority. Inspect author code and calibration drift safeguards before a run.

Primary paired MSE, temporal RRMSE, ordinary Pearson CC; output SNR and improvement
separate. Also report spectral and covariance preservation, runtime, fit failures
and pass-through. Gates unchanged: clean modification<=.01, alpha/beta<=.5dB,
covariance<=.02, CC deterioration<=.005. Evaluate comparator-specific deterioration
against both frozen matched context baselines and label comparator identity.
Controlled artifact fields are regression-generated and may favor regression;
EOG amplitude coupling is still imperfect. These are development experiments,
not independent validation or production qualification. Native tests required.

Retain all failures. No method wins because it includes VMD. Best whole-system
SNR is assessed from composed waveforms, never summed regional dB. If the fixed
challengers fail, report their shortfall and use the existing frozen baseline.

2. **NF11 weak-artifact conservative gain — proposed.** Audit saved association,
   gain and artifact/EEG-energy ratios per condition first. The current method
   estimates its map on calibration, but region gain from observed scoring EEG;
   it is not a calibration-only gain. Neural contribution to this estimate is
   a plausible overcorrection mechanism, not an established root cause. Compare
   the existing gain with one calibration-constrained gain/shrinkage variant.
   Use the existing declared strength bank0.25/0.5/0.75/1 rather than inventing a
   broad search. If blending old and rank2 fields, use a=(1-w)*a_old+w*a_rank2 on
   disjoint nonfrontal rows, then subtract once from original. The weight must be

3. **NF12 reference CCA challenger — proposed.** Reuse verified calibration,

### CCA design sanity check before NF12

Original iCanClean identifies EEG/reference-correlated latent components, selects
them by squared canonical correlation, estimates sensor projections and subtracts.
Its paper distinguishes sources formed from EEG, references or both; its threshold
is R-squared, not R. Primary methods sections2/3.6.1:
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10574843/ . Human ocular use here remains
an adaptation; the cited benchmark uses a phantom and a source-recovery DataQuality
Score, not our reconstruction-SNR benchmark. Do not import its best-setting score.

A full-rank reference-side CCA plus unrestricted linear back-regression can reduce
to ordinary multivariate regression. With only two instantaneous EOG channels,
retaining both canonical directions may add no substantive method. Prove that
parity on Kaggle as a degeneracy fixture before claiming novelty. The distinct
bounded challenger would use the existing2EOGx3lag bank(sixfeatures), regularized
calibration-only whitening and rank1/2 truncation, followed by reference-supported
projection. Compare it with matched lagged ridge and currentrest-whitenedrank2.
EEG-side source subtraction is a separate preservation-risk control because
reference-correlated components can retain neural content. Label each source
choice explicitly; do not mix them under one unqualified CCA result.

If correlation admission is numerically matched to|CC|0.4, its squared threshold
is0.16, not0.4; this matching is our adaptation, not a verified published optimum.
No automatic posteriorVMD, waveform filtering as pseudo-clean truth, target-guided
component count, or assumption that a slow component is ocular is permitted.

source of every error, prove an optimal newmethod, or eliminate reference-coupling
and regression-generated-mixture bias.

# Posterior/middle regularized CCA adaptation

14October2026. User requested the next approach after fixed-strength diagnosis.
All numerical work runs on Kaggle. FrontalVMD K3/2000 stays frozen. AutoVMD,
neural training and reserved data remain closed.

## Scientific question and scope

Can calibration-selected EEG/EOG canonical directions improve the artifact field
when scalar gain cannot fix severe lateral reconstruction? Six fixedmethods:
directjointlagridge; previousrest-whitenedreference-rank2; referenceCCA rank1/2;
EEGCCA rank1/2. Each has posterior-only,central-only andboth compositions, plus
identity and two inheritedcontextcontrols:21arms. Same exactcorpus002 and
matched-context-full001 parents, unscoredcalibration, lagbank[-10,0,10], ridge.01,
fieldadmission.4 andgaincap8. No broadsearch or scoring-target fitting.

## Literature and labelled adaptations

Primary paper and author implementation:
https://doi.org/10.3390/s23198214
https://github.com/downeyryanj/iCanClean
The paper uses CCA to identify reference-correlated directions, choose candidate
noise components and subtract a regressed projection. Its cited ocular benchmark
is phantomEEG, not evidence of our human reconstructionSNR. Reference-side,
EEG-side and joint source choices are distinct. Our frozen-calibration,regularized,
lagged lowrank implementation is an adaptation. MATLAB parity and published
settings are not claimed. Source code is newly authored; author code is not vendored.

## Algorithm and interfaces

fit_experts(calibrationEEG,references,masks,trialtypes,boundaries,policy) accepts
no scoringtarget,trueartifact or generationmultiplier. Standardize EEG and lagged
reference predictors using valid calibration moments. Exclude outerlag edges and
trialjoin edges before covariance estimation. Whiten both covariance matrices
withfixedregularization.01 in standardizedcoordinates; SVD their crosscovariance.
Record regularizedsingularvalues and actual paired calibrationPearsonCC separately.
Admit canonicaldirections at squared actualCC>=.16, corresponding to|CC|>=.4.
This threshold matching is a project choice, not the paper's publishedoptimum.
Retain first1/2admitteddirections in regularizedSVD order; fewer available are
explicitly recorded; no admitteddirection gives scoredpass-through withfailure.

Reference arm: truncate the standardizedreference design in canonical coordinates
then apply the same frozenridgecoefficients. Fullreferencebasis must reconstruct
identity and exactly reproduce matchedridge within numericaltolerance. Rank1/2
truncation, rather than naming a fullrank regressionCCA, is the substantivechange.

EEG arm: apply calibrated canonicalEEG directions to scoringEEG and the calibrated
ridgebackprojection. These directions can retain neuralcontent; use as a separate
preservation-risk control. Every branch uses the same originalinput fieldassociation
gate. Referencearms estimate a boundedregion gain from observedEEG/candidatefield;
EEGarms preserve unitcorrection strength. HEOG/VEOG access and differences are
reported. No target, conditionlabel or knowninputSNR enters correction.

Outputonly verified regions1/2. Frontal andunknown/maskedrows remain frozen.
Each regional correction refers to originalEEG and is composed once. Save fitted
matrices,means/scales,actualCC,admissionindices,regularizedspectra,coefficients,
rank andfailures. Reload and replay every fit bit-for-bit before scoring.

Producerinspection confirms legacycorpus fields are scaled while EOGreferences

# Next regional validation stage: provenance, frontal contribution and native EEG

14 October 2026. Active mode: Super Code for research design, with notebook-driven
implementation. This plan starts from the completed 17.533717 dB development
hybrid. It does not restart AutoVMD or replace the user's regional architecture.

## Starting evidence and unanswered questions

Frontal K3/alpha2000 VMD plus complete calibrated posterior/middle reference
ridge reaches 17.533717 dB channel-first mean, 14.780705 dB pooled-window mean,
MSE 3.546698e-12 V², temporal RRMSE .191564 and CC .972400. The severe lateral

ridge, with matched CCA-minus-ridge SNR interval [-2.548602, -.943181] dB and

These are development-exposed, EOG-assisted, regression-generated results.
Earlier raw-frontal regression is stronger than fixed VMD on frontal channels;
the exact new full-ridge system still lacks that matched frontend comparison.
Earlier native resting modification/covariance gates fail. The old synthetic
producer scales injected ocular fields but leaves supplied EOG arrays unscaled.
An affine, lag-centered field cannot be repaired merely by multiplying raw EOG.

The three questions are: do we have trustworthy source/calibration inputs; what
does frontal VMD add while nonfrontal output is identical; does the retained
hybrid suppress both ocular types while meeting native preservation limits?

review can run separately. N03 depends on N01; N04 on N03; N05 on N04. Native
source/dependency auditing can run alongside N01/N02, but method evaluation waits
for frozen eligible calibration contracts. No broad posterior search is repeated.

N01 selects two recipients lexicographically from the already-scored development
cohort, requiring different donor identities/folds, with first chronological
recipient window and exact donor record from their archived recipe. Selection
must not use SNR, method predictions or failures. Use immutable original LEMON
archive/header hashes. Save source prefix arrays; original raw archives can be
temporary, with source URL/hash and repaired-header evidence retained. OSF cache
physical units absent from source metadata remain unknown: use explicit original
numeric driver units, not an invented volts conversion or physical sensor claim.
This audit recovers prerequisites; it does not repair coupling or qualify accuracy.

## Coupled generator definition

Fit the donor field using only its original unscored calibration, with a declared
per-reference baseline and signed lag operator. Define reference excursions R
relative to that frozen baseline and F(R)=B D^-1 L(R), with valid lag samples
masked independently at trial boundaries. The operator must have no affine
intercept. Generated calibration/scoring each use a single multiplier a:
injected field=aF(R), generated reference excursion=aR. Clean injection uses
zero driver and zero field; its easy identity result cannot establish real false
positive behavior. The recipient reference EEG remains low-ocular, not proven
artifact-free. Regression-derived generation bias remains after coupling repair.

Do not reuse old VMD caches on changed inputs. Do not reconstruct unavailable
recipient calibration from contaminated arrays. Keep source generation evidence
separate from estimator input. A consistent generator might leave gain-adjusted
outputs unchanged; an SNR increase is not an acceptance condition for this repair.

## Decision rules and bounded improvement path

N02 can establish contribution on the legacy corpus, not fresh generalization.
If fixed frontal VMD loses, preserve it as the requested research branch while
reporting the stronger raw control. Do not silently relabel regression gain as
VMD benefit. On N05/6 diagnose gate misses, retained-field direction errors,
amplitude errors, timing errors and clean false positives separately.

Only after that diagnosis choose one challenger: separate signed HEOG/VEOG
time-dependent reference projection for missed lateral intervals, or calibrated
signed frontal-artifact transfer where raw EOG coverage is inadequate. Existing
full-ridge output stays the matched control. No new decomposition parameter
search. Eligible author SGEYESUB needs six explicit movement/rest labels; four
OSF trial codes or HEOG sign are not substitute labels. Generic ASR/ICA/SOBI
queues are deferred unless evidence identifies a distinct unresolved mechanism.

## Evaluation and completion checklist

Paper primary: MSE, temporal RRMSE, ordinary Pearson CC; output SNR and improvement
separate. Additional spectral RRMSE only under its declared paper implementation.
Native suppression: original unchanged-reference HEOG for lateral, VEOG for
blink/vertical, resting RMSE and spectra following the prescribed protocol. Use
participant-level paper inference when eligible; label approximate recipient/
donor intervals as supplemental. Keep failed/low-scoring rows and both pooling
conventions visible. Region dB values cannot be added.

Unchanged engineering limits: worst-source clean modification<=1%, alpha/beta
error<=.5dB, relative covariance<=.02, CC deterioration<=.005 against declared
strongest matched direct comparator. Fresh controlled mean>=15dB,20stretch.
Neither self-comparator CC nor synthetic zero-driver preservation proves native
qualification. Two-pair pilots are engineering checks, not generalization tests.

# Bounded development-corpus reference-coupling repair

14 October 2026 IST. Proposed next engineering checkpoint, not implemented or
launched. The independent benchmark remains unavailable under the audited source
contracts. This repair does not turn the existing regression-generated corpus
into an independent or biologically clean benchmark.

## Problem and preserved evidence

In corpus.py the calibration EEG receives a scaled donor field while its EOG
references retain their source amplitude. Scoring EEG receives another mixture
multiplier while its EOG references remain unscaled. The existing gain estimates
partly compensate, but EOG amplitude-based support and calibration-to-scoring
interpretation do not represent consistently coupled generated sensor signals.
This was previously disclosed; the source audit confirms it rather than discovering
a new performance failure. Preserve all original arrays, hashes, splits, metrics
and the17.112814dB frontal VMD baseline.

## Scope and constraints

Create a separate, explicitly named development-corpus version and pilot protocol.
Reuse verified recipient/donor identities and only their already eligible
development partitions. Keep all confirmation and external reserved sources
closed. Preserve sampling/filtering/window/trial contracts and separate calibration
from scoring before construction. The inference APIs still receive no paired
target, true artifact, generation multiplier or future samples.

The producer must define a reference baseline and a homogeneous signed forward
operator F on the reference excursions: F(aR)=aF(R). Apply the same source multiplier
to the generated reference excursion and injected field, independently for
calibration and scoring. Do not just multiply raw references while leaving an
affine offset or inconsistent lag-specific baseline in the field generator.
Record baseline, coefficients, units, finite-lag masks, source multiplier and
operator identity as generation evidence. Such values are producer/evaluator
information and remain inaccessible to correction functions.

Reacquire or reuse checksum-verified unscored recipient prefixes and original
donor calibration where necessary. Do not reconstruct an unavailable recipient
prefix from a mixed calibration array by an unverified algebraic assumption.
Unknown physical source units remain explicitly unknown; generated driver-unit
conventions must be documented. Do not introduce invented neural leakage, field
signs, head geometry or learned propagation parameters.

Retain identity, calibrated raw and original full-field frontal K3/alpha2000 VMD.
No additional method or K/alpha bank. New EEG inputs require their own exact
waveform/source/cache identities; historical mode bundles cannot be reused merely
because channel names match. Posterior and unknown/masked rows remain pass-through.

## Modular tasks and gates

| Part | Input | Output | Acceptance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RC01 provenance audit | donor/recipient/calibration manifests and producer code | recoverable unscored source and baseline contract | exact source, reference, units, split and boundary identities; no guessed reconstruction |
| RC02 generator contract | verified sources and declared homogeneous operator | versioned coupled EEG/reference records | consistent multipliers, finite boundaries and target-only producer access |
| RC03 Kaggle fixtures | small controlled examples | numerical linearity, zero-drive, scaling, lag/baseline and leakage checks | all tests pass; no local numerical work |
| RC04 bounded source pilot | two deterministic eligible development recipient/donor pairs | saved calibration and clean/blink/lateral/mixed records | new hashes, complete recovery, reserved sources closed |
| RC05 matched frontal pilot | verified new records and three frozen methods | paper metrics, preservation, runtime and failure tables | equal information access; frontal-only VMD; no superiority/promotion assumed |

Clean zero-driver controls are idealized and cannot establish native false-positive
behavior. Real EOG donor waveforms may contain nonocular activity. Paired references
remain retained recipient EEG. Regression-derived field bias and prior native
preservation failures remain unresolved. Coupling repair may leave a gain-adjusted
method's output unchanged; an SNR increase is not guaranteed.

Keep the old and repaired corpus comparisons distinct. Any further source or
generator change needs its own identity/protocol. IB02-IB04 independent-benchmark
work and model promotion stay closed until their separate scientific requirements
are met.

launched. This replaces an open-ended sequence of speculative correction variants
with a bounded, residual-driven decision. The separate reference-coupling repair
remains a data-consistency requirement, not a promised accuracy improvement.

## Fixed constraints

Keep frontal-only K=3, alpha=2000; AutoVMD and broad searches stay stopped.
Keep the original corpus immutable, frozen recipient/donor partitions and closed
confirmation sources. All numerical work runs on Kaggle with pinned published
source and versioned parents. Use paper MSE, temporal RRMSE and ordinary CC;
report output SNR and improvement separately. Apply the existing preservation
gates against the strongest declared matched comparator. No target enters inference.

Do not repeat separate HEOG/VEOG gains, event-mask banks, selected-mode field
projection, DC shape projection or the unsuccessful frozen neural transfer as
new hypotheses. Their negative results are already documented.

## Bounded execution and decisions

| Task | Inputs and deliverable | Acceptance / next decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SI01 Freeze baseline evidence | Exact original/raw predictions, fields, modes, decisions and grouped identities | Recoverable parent checksums and baseline parity; no changed predictions |
| SI02 One lateral residual diagnosis | Saved development predictions and evaluator-only clean targets; report trigger misses, field-shape mismatch, mode-related gain bias and spatial gain disagreement separately | Close the error accounting and identify which limitation dominates; diagnostic target-fitted gains are labelled optimistic bounds and never deployed |
| SI03 Repair reference coupling | RC01-RC05 source/baseline/lag contracts and separately named tiny corpus pilot | Consistent EEG/reference excursions; no benchmark substitution or claimed independent validity; if original unscored sources cannot be verified, report that dependency and do not reconstruct them by assumption |
| SI04 One conditional classical challenger | Choose only from the measured SI02 mechanism; keep full artifact field | Pass focused fixtures and a small source-grouped development pilot before broader evaluation |
| SI05 Matched development comparison | Identity, original VMD, strongest raw, challenger and the same challenger without VMD | Better lateral reconstruction without overall accuracy/CC or clean-preservation regression; uncertainty must support a VMD benefit before claiming one |
| SI06 Native preservation check | Unchanged-reference blink/lateral proxies and resting modification/spectra/covariance | Existing gates unchanged; low EEG-EOG correlation alone cannot qualify the system |
| SI07 Regional integration | Qualified frontal correction and other chat's versioned posterior candidates | Disjoint masks, original-input artifact estimates, one subtraction and whole-montage scoring; never add regional dB |
| SI08 EEG-only student | Selected qualified classical system and grouped paired targets | Classical-first sequencing retained; compact temporal CNN/TCN baseline before a recurrent model, with matched no-VMD control and teacher supervision only when it improves paired-only learning |

### SI02 diagnosis contract

Do not launch another artifact-shape recipe simply because its name sounds more
advanced. On saved lateral cases, compare the current inferred scalar gain with
an evaluator-only least-squares scalar bound for the same full field. Then use
an evaluator-only left/right/midline bound to determine whether one global gain
is the bottleneck. Report remaining error after each bound by recipient, donor,
input level and condition. Include untriggered and decomposition-failed cases.
Bounds fit scoring targets and are optimistic diagnostics, not validation scores.

If the full field cannot explain the true controlled artifact even with an
optimistic scalar, changing gain alone is insufficient. If grouping adds no
material headroom, do not implement spatial gain fitting. Saved metadata must
verify anatomical groups; insufficient grouping means the hypothesis is ineligible.

### SI04 conditional challenger

If regional gain mismatch dominates, test partially pooled left/right/midline
gains regularized toward the original global gain. This changes spatial sharing,
not the previously rejected independent HEOG/VEOG-axis recipe. Scoring fits may
use EEG/references and verified frontal modes, never paired targets. Fit any
shrinkage selection only within grouped development training/validation sources;
preserve the complete calibration-derived artifact field. Risks include fitting
neural activity and calibration mismatch; clean and native gates are mandatory.

If the diagnostic instead identifies transfer-waveform mismatch, repair the
calibration transfer representation first with a matched raw control. Declare
one bounded hypothesis before coding; do not automatically open a new lag grid.
If selected-mode observations bias gain while raw observations are accurate,
report that VMD currently hurts this stage. Reusing raw observations is a valid
control, but does not establish that VMD improves the method.

If neither diagnosis supports a credible classical improvement, stop this
challenger sequence. Record a concrete proposal to change classical-first
sequencing for paired neural research rather than silently starting training or
weakening teacher/native qualification requirements.

## Stop rules and scope

Run one diagnostic notebook and at most one supported challenger pilot before
reassessment. A completed audit or passing software test is not an SNR gain.
Do not promote a pilot trained/selected on its scoring sources. Retain all
failed arms and per-record predictions. The 15/20 dB targets remain targets;
there is no guaranteed route to 20 dB or claim of production qualification.

An independent paired benchmark is still unresolved. Do not let its metadata
search replace the bounded development improvement experiment, and do not call
the reference-coupling repair an independent benchmark.

## Paired uncertainty and interpretation

The table reports candidate minus comparator. This is the declared project
recipient/donor Poisson multiplier approximation, not a paper-native metric or

# Frontal shape failure: frozen-output diagnostic

13 October 2026. The diagnostic completed, and the tested error identity explains
the rejected fixed projection's reconstruction penalty. Retain the original
calibrated full artifact estimate. No correction or recipe changed in this run.

## Exact evidence

  recovery verified16:20:28UTC. Runtime and API elapsed time differ.

## What the diagnostic measures

Let A be the original full estimated artifact, B the shaped artifact and D=A-B.
The full corrected error is e=x-A-s for fixed input x and fixed paired reference s.
The shaped error is e+D. Therefore

    MSE(shape) - MSE(full) = mean(D squared) + 2 mean(e times D).

The first term measures variation removed from the correction. The second reports
its interaction with the original reconstruction error; it can be positive or
negative, as covered by fixtures. Both are retrospective evaluation quantities.
They cannot fit an inference parameter or establish the neural/ocular content of
D. Sources are low-ocular recipient references with regression-generated ocular
contamination, and the cohort was development-exposed. Unit labels remain the
stored squared signal unit.

## Decision and scope

The projection omitted a contribution that was useful for reconstruction in this
controlled experiment. Its reduction in correction energy did not improve
accuracy. Production-case subtraction/DC/edge checks and paper-MSE parity passed;
there is no evidence here for a sign, unit, channel-axis or baseline-loading error.
This does not exclude every defect, establish that VMD generally fails, or prove
biological neural loss. The rejected operator restricted a calibrated artifact to
a contaminated EEG-derived selected-mode span; mode membership is not a verified
ocular subspace label.

Stop native extraction for this rejected shape variant and retain the stronger
original full-field VMD correction. A further experiment must preserve that
baseline and investigate a distinct frontal/lateral mechanism or independent
contamination benchmark. The original lateral and native preservation deficits
remain unresolved; posterior integration and neural promotion are not qualified.
No AutoVMD, parameter search, field/gain fit, new decomposition, prediction change,
model training or reserved confirmation access occurred. All numerical work ran
on Kaggle. Local work was authoring, static review, hashes and formatting saved
results. See FRONTAL_ARTIFACT_SHAPE_RESULTS.md for the17.112814/18.193247/2.521295dB
comparison, primary paper metrics and uncertainty.

## What was compared

Extended Picard ICA and Ledoit-Wolf regularized GEVD–MWF each used five support
options: posterior-only, a common frontal average, signed frontal summaries,
raw frontal channels and the full montage. Outputs correct posterior channels
only. Signed summaries retain separate left/right/midline signals, common
activity and right-minus-left activity, with availability flags.

Experts fit on unscored calibration EEG/EOG. ICA component/reference lagged
association excludes calibration trial joins. Every correction is estimated
relative to the original EEG and subtracted once. The final frontal/posterior
composition has a separate contract rejecting overlapping output masks.

The full MWF grid searched ranks 1–4, lags `[0]` or
`[-10, -5, 0, 5, 10]`, thresholds 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 and strengths
0.25/0.5/0.75/1. ICA searched the same thresholds and strengths. The joint
HEOG/VEOG ridge comparator used instantaneous references and penalty 0.01;
this was a fixed regression comparator, not a full regression parameter search.

Scoring used one deterministic window per eligible recipient, condition and
input level: clean controls plus blink, lateral and mixed mixtures at −5/0/+5 dB.
Preprocessing remained 200 Hz, 0.5–40 Hz, 1,024 samples and 512-sample hop.

may differ between rows. This table is not an aggregate of the separate
source-excluded fold evaluation and must not be presented as a final held-out
estimate or statistically established superiority.

|---|---|---:|---:|

The four strongest candidates in the initial status report—direct regression,
full-montage ICA, signed-summary ICA and signed-summary MWF—have **0.0 recorded
worst-recipient mean clean relative modification** in this search. That reflects
the algorithm's EOG association gate on these scored clean examples. It does not
prove that the method preserves all native resting EEG or has no neural loss
during ocular events.

## Metrics and interpretation

Primary paired measures are the existing paper-mapped MSE, temporal RRMSE and
ordinary Pearson CC. Output SNR uses the explicitly declared target:

\[
\mathrm{SNR}_{out}=10\log_{10}\frac{\sum_t s(t)^2}
{\sum_t[s(t)-\hat{s}(t)]^2}.
\]

SNR is computed per posterior channel before aggregation: channel mean, then
condition/input-level balance, then equal recipient weighting. Output SNR and
improvement are distinct. A montage-level 0 dB mixture does not imply 0 dB
contamination in the posterior subset, so output SNR cannot be interpreted as
the amount of improvement by itself. MSE uses retained recipient volts squared.

**The 15 dB target is not met in this table.** Full-montage ICA is close to the
direct regression comparator; the table does not demonstrate ICA superiority.
Signed summaries outperform a common average in the best-candidate ranking for
each spatial method, but a matched-parameter, source-excluded comparison with
uncertainty is required before claiming a causal benefit from signed context.

## What remains before teacher qualification

- Review the saved source-excluded fold selections and scores, with separate
  blink/lateral/mixed outcomes and input levels; report recipient/donor-aware
  uncertainty rather than treating windows as independent participants.
- Complete the paired-correlation deterioration gate against the declared
  comparator. The current screen covers clean relative modification,
  alpha/beta error and covariance only; it is explicitly partial.
- Evaluate frozen candidates on native OSF ocular trials and resting EEG using
  unchanged HEOG/VEOG correlations and resting preservation. Native unpaired EEG
  has no valid reconstruction SNR.
- Integrate a qualified posterior expert with the frontal branch and evaluate
  the whole montage. These posterior numbers do not establish a VMD benefit.
- Qualify cross-fitted teacher targets before distillation. Channel scalability,
  deployment accuracy and production readiness are not established here.

## Dataset and method limitations

LEMON recipients are low-ocular references, not proven artifact-free EEG.
Controlled ocular fields were derived from donor-calibration EOG regression,
which may favor EOG-assisted methods. These ICA/MWF experiments use EOG and own
unscored participant/donor calibration; they are not EEG-only deployment results.

Signed virtual channels are redundant linear combinations. ICA rank reduction
and MWF covariance regularization handle that redundancy differently, so an
observed difference cannot automatically be attributed to lateral polarity alone.
Unknown Klados channel/participant mappings remain unknown; this comparison does
not establish Klados anatomical or participant-specific results.

## 2026-10-15 — Repaired coupled pilot implementation

Implemented `coupled_pilot.py`, explicit immutable-parent configuration and notebook 68. Two source-only pairs remain fixed from the recovered source audit. Each generates one idealized zero-driver clean control plus blink/lateral/mixed at -5/0/+5 dB. Calibration ends on a whole donor-trial boundary within the recovered recipient prefix. Original annotated scoring donors are separated from calibration trials. Homogeneous field and EOG excursions share one multiplier; paired targets and generation parameters remain producer/evaluator truth. Checks cover replay, finite arrays, nominal input SNR and channel identity. No VMD or model is run by this stage. Regression-generated bias and unknown native cleanliness remain. Local validation is AST/JSON only; numerical tests and integration are pending Kaggle execution. AutoVMD remains stopped.

### Coupled pilot version 1 failure and repair

`coupled-pilot-001` at ecd3cfc passed 315 Kaggle tests (17.25 s), then stopped at the strict generated input-SNR assertion before completing the first pair. All 12 manifest payloads were recovered and verified; completion is false. Root cause: source preprocessing stores float32, whereas generated_pair converts targets to float64; the caller recomputed target energy in float32 against float64 artifact energy with a 1e-9 dB numerical tolerance. Repair validates the actual float64 paired reference used by the producer, without changing its sample values or relaxing the tolerance. Added a float32-source regression fixture that also rejects wrong SNR and mismatched reference scaling. Version 2 must pass Kaggle tests and the real producer before downstream work. No accuracy or qualification claim.

### Fixed frontal coupled review authored, awaiting eligible parent

Added coupled_frontal_review with five fixed arms: identity, raw frontal/pass-through, VMD frontal/pass-through, raw frontal/nonfrontal full ridge and VMD frontal/same full ridge. New modes are frontal-only K3/2000 with source input hashes, reconstruction checks, residuals and solver metadata. Fits and correction APIs receive only observed EEG/references/calibration/metadata; paired targets enter after predictions exist. Saves per-channel/record metrics, both SNR aggregations, regional CC and clean preservation checks, failures via mode metadata and diagnostic figure. This is a two-pair engineering pilot, not full grouped or native qualification. Added nonfrontal mask-protection fixture. Local AST only; numerical acceptance must run on Kaggle after complete verified producer recovery.

`coupled-pilot-002/2` at 7c289d307b71298559b8b394f6e3d5f3e06247b8 completed: 316 tests, 14 warnings, 22.12 s tests; producer 9.654715 s; 20 records from two development pairs. The float32-source fixture and real pilot now pass without tolerance relaxation. This is construction evidence, not a cleaning SNR or teacher qualification. ### 2026-10-15 — Fixed frontal review version 1 failure and repair

`coupled-frontal-review-001/1` at 859e92b passed 317 Kaggle tests (22.03 s), then failed the newly authored mode reconstruction assertion after partial progress. Failed output recovered: all 26 manifest payloads verified, completion false. One sample exceeded the pointwise check with 2.79333e-12 V error. The solver stores float32 modes/residuals, whereas the new check reduced modes in float32 against float64 EEG. Replaced this check with float64 accumulation and an explicit pointwise quantization budget based on storage epsilon and component magnitudes, plus double arithmetic roundoff. Save actual error and budget. No solver, K/alpha, output correction or scientific preservation threshold changed. New regression fixture accepts float32 cancellation-rounding and rejects corrupted modes and invalid shapes. Version 2 must pass the fixture and real records before any inference from results.

### 2026-10-15 — Literature-led lateral gain repair authored

Re-reviewed primary literature: Plochl et al.2012 distinct ocular generators, frontal VMD-regression2020 lateral coverage, Issa/Juhasz2019 selective interval correction, Schlogl2007 reference regression, Berg/Scherg1994 multiple-source correction, Liu/Zhang2022 VMD-SOBI. alphaXiv discovery and PDF lookup were used; three title lookups returned unrelated citing papers and were rejected, with publisher/PMC/author evidence used instead. Full review, limits and implementation choices: docs/LATERAL_REPAIR_REVIEW_20261015.md. Added projected_axis gain as a declared project adaptation: project separate signed reference fields into each selected frontal-mode span, fit two regularized bounded gains from observed data, subtract full calibrated axis estimates once. No scoring target or condition label enters inference. Notebook70 compares archived identity/raw-shared/VMD-shared, matched VMD scalar, raw axis and projected VMD axis. Exact corpus002 and review002 parents pin the same input hashes/modes and nonfrontal outputs; no new VMD or parameter search. Added polarity, gain, unit, channel/mode permutation, missing-axis, failed-mode and no-support contracts. Local AST/JSON validation only; Kaggle numerical acceptance and actual lateral improvement remain pending.

### Lateral repair version 1 stopped at a valid identifiability contract

`lateral-gain-review-001/1` at c7caaec passed 321 tests but failed the new projected-axis variant of the existing signed-field recovery test. All seven failed manifest payloads recovered; no data experiment began. The fixture collapses the joint ocular field into a single mode per channel. Separate projected axes then become nearly collinear: normalized zero-centered ridge can fit the projected signal while assigning incompatible gains to the restored full fields. This is an algorithmic failure, not storage precision. Repair: regularize the projected-axis fit around the matched-subspace shared physical gain, rather than zero; use the same declared penalty0.01, save the prior and Gram eigenvalues. Keep the failing recovery assertion unchanged. Existing raw-axis and scalar controls remain unchanged. Version2 must pass all contracts before numerical comparison.
